edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Ownable constructor assigns startdate = now.
msg.sender becomes the owner in the constructor.
block.timestamp (now) is stored into startdate.
Constructor reads msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier defined on Ownable.
isLockAddress modifier passes msg.sender into check_lock_period.
check_lock_period compares now against the stored lock period (timestamp dependency).
check_address parameter indexes _lock_list_period and _lock_list.
check_lock_period reads _lock_list_period of the address.
check_lock_period clears the _lock_list flag.
check_lock_period reads locked balances from _balances.
check_lock_period adds released balances back into _tokenSupply.
set_lock_list uses msg.sender through the onlyOwner modifier.
set_lock_list computes period from startdate.
set_lock_list writes the lock expiry into _lock_list_period.
set_lock_list sets the lock flag in _lock_list.
set_lock_list subtracts locked balances from _tokenSupply.
set_lock_list is gated by the onlyOwner modifier inherited from Ownable.
pause is restricted by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
unpause is restricted by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
unpause sets the paused flag to false.
unpause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
NTH constructor initializes _tokenSupply to zero.
NTH constructor computes _totalSupply from decimals exponentiation.
mint is protected by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
mint is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
amount parameter is scaled and added to supply and balance.
to parameter is credited in the _balances mapping.
mint performs unscaled multiplication and supply addition arithmetic.
Arithmetic result updates _tokenSupply.
Arithmetic result updates _balances.
Arithmetic result is compared against the _totalSupply cap.

dist_list_set is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
dist_list addresses are iterated and transferred to.
token_list amounts are iterated and transferred.

_data parameter passed through transferToAddress.

token_list array is only consumed by the batch transfer loop of dist_list_set.
transfer destination parameter belongs to the transfer dispatch.
transfer token amount parameter belongs to the transfer dispatch.

transferToAddress value parameter is local to that helper.
transferToAddress data parameter is unused plumbing for that helper.

transferToContract data parameter flows into tokenFallback.
